stem.text: The bonding between two atoms of nitrogen in an $\text{N}_2$ molecule involves the hybridisation of atomic orbitals to form sp orbitals.

A.text: an sp orbital from one atom overlaps with an sp orbital of the other atom; p

B.text: an sp orbital from one atom overlaps with an sp orbital of the other atom; sp

C.text: an s orbital from one atom overlaps with a p orbital of the other atom; p

D.text: an s orbital from one atom overlaps with a p orbital of the other atom; sp
